あらすじ

Michael is a genius sorcerer. His ambition is to conquer the world…

One day, Michael and his troops start invading the kingdom of Diastan with Michael’s motto, “Everything in this world is pleasure and game.”

As he gets to know what’s going on in Diastan, he finds the fact that there is a mystery in the kingdom…

item.title: Reijou Gakuen 2 ~Shigyaku no Hanazono~
item.description:

  • ブランド: Psy-chs
  • 発売日: 2008-01-25
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 隷嬢学園2～嗜虐の花園～
  • 英語名: Reijou Gakuen 2 Shigyaku no Hanazono

あらすじ

Keisuke had a promised future, a well-paid job and a beautiful fiancee…. But he was betrayed by a man and lost everything. He decides to take revenge and starts working at a girls’ high school. By taking advantage of his position as a teacher, he rapes female students randomly. As he goes like this, he gets to know a secret about the school. Yes, there was a serial murder case at the school in the past….

item.title: Shuumatsu Iryou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Psy-chs
  • 発売日: 2006-11-23
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 終末医凌
  • 英語名: Shuumatsu Iryou

あらすじ

Main character is a son of a large company CEO. His good friend and secret love object Takumi Saeki becomes young director of the hospital. Suppressed feelings gradually turn into negative emotions. With the beginning of recession hospital undergoes a serious crisis. Protagonist decides to use this moment and give hospital a loan under severe conditions to drag female personnel to the bottom of despair. He overruns the body of a nurse who comes to negotiate. And this is only the beginning of the drama to take place here.

item.title: Ryouki 2 ~Ayashiku Ugomeku Inbou no Enbukyoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Psy-chs
  • 発売日: 2005-10-28
  • スコア: 6.7700000000000005/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 凌姫II～妖しく蠢く淫謀の円舞曲～
  • 英語名: Ryouki 2 Ayashiku Ugomeku Inbou no Enbukyoku

あらすじ

The emperor and empress of the revered Phoenicia Empire fell ill. Shortly after, the empress passed away, and the emperor’s condition teetered between life and death. Rumors spread that the emperor’s symptoms might be due to a curse, leading to a witch hunt within and outside the palace. Concerned about the situation, princesses Leticia and Iria organized an imperial guard to quell the unrest. Amidst this, a low-ranking knight named Leon, believing he has royal blood, sought to exploit the chaos to eliminate rival royals.

item.title: Ryouki ~Midara ni Hibiku Fukushuu no Rondo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Psy-chs
  • 発売日: 2004-01-30
  • スコア: 6.590000000000001/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 凌姫～淫らに響く復讐の輪舞曲～
  • 英語名: Ryouki Midara ni Hibiku Fukushuu no Rondo

あらすじ

The protagonist, Van Renborg, and his sister were nobles but trapped in the clutches of the king’s desires, enduring days filled with shame and humiliation. Van’s sister, driven to despair, commits suicide. Fueled by hatred, Van plots a coup but fails, ending up imprisoned. Consumed by resentment, he is unexpectedly visited by princess Eldia, offering Van a chance for revenge by asking him to overthrow her sister, Filia, who holds a higher succession right. Eldia promises to restore Van’s status in exchange for his assistance, unaware that she is resurrecting a vengeful spirit that will ensnare them both in the chains of depravity.
